ok I am absolutely fuming and I’m posting this on my personal page, not the shop page, because this is my drawing and my problem.

Deb sent me a listing tonight from a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co. they’re selling something called “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” for $6.50, or 3 for $15, and it is my switchblade moth. not a similar moth. not a moth with a knife that happens to have the same vibe. MY moth.

I drew it for the september 13 flash day and posted the sheet on august 30. it got tattooed in the first hour. the sticker has the same wing pattern, the same little crack in the blade, the same linework, all of it. they didn’t even flip it. this is not “inspired by,” it’s a straight scan of my drawing that somebody else is now making money on.

so I messaged them, told them exactly where it came from, told them I have the original drawing and the august 30 post, and asked them to take it down because nobody had permission to print it. their response was basically “love your work!” followed by “moths are a very common tattoo motif” and then they told me to send a registered copyright through their support form.

sure. moths are common. cracks in blades appearing in the exact same place and entire wing patterns matching line for line are not. love my work enough to stop selling it maybe?? they basically told me to pound sand with a smiley little “have a great day!” at the end.

and here’s the part that actually makes me sick. the person who got this tattoo messaged me tonight because somebody showed them the sticker and they thought I was the one selling it.

to that client: no. absolutely not. I did not sell your tattoo. I did not license the design for stickers, I did not give these people permission, and I have not made one cent from that listing. I’m not putting your name or anything else about you out here, but I need you to know that.

my flash is sold ONE time to ONE person. that’s the whole deal. when somebody claims a design, that’s their tattoo and I retire the design. they paid for that. so these people aren’t just helping themselves to my drawing, they’re taking something that was supposed to belong to one person and turning water bottle merch out of it.

small shops don’t have lawyer money sitting around for this crap and these sticker places know it. they make the process just annoying enough that artists give up and they keep the listing up.

if you want to help, please go report StickerBurrow Co’s “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” listing for copied/stolen artwork and don’t buy from them. no threats or weird dogpiling, just report the listing. apparently one artist asking nicely isn’t enough.
